hook: He did it again. *Ray-Ban Meta Glasses*, AI, and a MacBook to cheat at chess against a Frenchman
caption:
He did it again. This guy returned to the park with his Ray-Ban Meta glasses to cheat at chess using AI, this time against a French player who confidently told him he was going to destroy him.
The setup works the same way as his first experiment.
The camera in his glasses streams the chessboard through a WhatsApp video call to a MacBook, where AI identifies the pieces and Stockfish, one of the world's strongest chess engines, calculates the best moves.
The MacBook then reads the moves aloud through the call, allowing him to hear each instruction directly through his glasses without ever looking at a screen.
It's his second demonstration of how consumer smart glasses and widely available software can give someone access to a powerful chess engine during a real-world match.
